root_cause.text: The error path in create_space_info_sub_group() calls kfree(sub_group) after btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() has already freed it via the kobject release callback (space_info_release), resulting in a double free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message describes the exact call chain: "btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() -> kobject_init_and_add() -> failure -> kobject_put(&sub_group->kobj) -> space_info_release() -> kfree(sub_group)" and then "btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type() returns error -> kfree(sub_group)". The patch removes the redundant kfree(sub_group) and only sets parent->sub_group[index] = NULL.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential double-free or incorrect cleanup in create_space_info_sub_group error path by removing redundant kfree.
intent_record.what: Removed the kfree(sub_group) call from the error handling block of create_space_info_sub_group, leaving only the assignment parent->sub_group[index] = NULL.
intent_record.how: Previously, if btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type failed, sub_group was freed and the parent pointer was set to NULL. Now, sub_group is not freed on failure; only the pointer is cleared, which prevents a potential double-free or use-after-free if the memory is owned by another subsystem.
